intro.heading: Meet Sahra
intro.body: Sahra Haji-Mohamed Said is a Registered Social Worker (RSW) with over a decade of clinical experience and up to fifteen years of community work supporting children, teens, adults, seniors, and families. She offers a warm, non-judgmental space where your story is heard with care — and where your cultural and spiritual background is honoured, not sidelined. Sahra believes you already carry the strength to reclaim control of your life; her role is simply to help you see your own resilience.

about.heading: About Sahra
about.bio: For over ten years, I have walked alongside children, teens, adults, seniors, and families as they work through some of the hardest chapters of their lives. My path began in early childhood education and community work — up to fifteen years of it — before I became a Registered Social Worker, and that community grounding still shapes how I practice today: with patience, humility, and deep respect for where each person comes from. I was born into a rich cultural and spiritual tradition, and I bring that same sensitivity into the therapy room, whether we're speaking English, French, or Somali. Your beliefs, your family structure, your community — none of it needs to be set aside here. It's part of what we work with, not around.
about.philosophy: I believe you have the strength to reclaim control; let me help you see your resilience.

approach.firstSessionHeading: What to Expect in Your First Session
approach.firstSession: Your first session is about getting comfortable, not diagnosing you. We'll talk through what brought you in, what you're hoping will feel different, and any questions you have about how therapy works. There's no pressure to share more than you're ready to. By the end, we'll have a plan for what the next few sessions might look like — one you helped shape.

fees.insuranceDetails: We provide detailed receipts so you can submit for reimbursement through your insurance plan. Direct billing is being introduced and will include Desjardins, First Nations Health Authority, and school boards once active — ask us for the current status.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Answers to common questions about sessions, fees, confidentiality, and more.

firstSession.question: What happens in my first session?
firstSession.answer: We'll start by getting to know each other. You'll share what brought you in and what you're hoping for, and I'll explain how I work. There's no obligation to share more than you're comfortable with — the goal is simply to see if we're a good fit.

onlineSessions.question: Are online sessions available?
onlineSessions.answer: Yes. Sessions are available both in person at our Ottawa office and online via secure video call, whichever works best for you.

feesInsurance.question: What are your fees, and do you accept insurance?
feesInsurance.answer: Individual sessions are $170 and couple sessions are $227, with a sliding scale available based on eligibility. We provide detailed receipts for insurance reimbursement, and direct billing is being introduced.

freeConsult.question: How does the free 15-minute consultation work?
freeConsult.answer: It's a short, no-obligation call or video chat to see if we're a good fit, ask any questions, and decide on next steps together — no cost, no pressure.

confidentiality.question: How is my privacy protected?
confidentiality.answer: Everything you share is confidential, in line with professional and legal standards for social workers in Ontario. Details are in our Privacy Policy.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How Anfa Counselling & Psychotherapy collects, uses, and protects your information.
privacy.body: Anfa Counselling & Psychotherapy is committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with Ontario's Personal Health Information Protection Act (PHIPA) and the federal Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). Our public website forms (booking requests and contact messages) collect only your name, email, phone number, and any short message you choose to share, along with your explicit consent to be contacted — we never ask for diagnoses, symptoms, or other sensitive health information through these forms. Submissions are stored securely in our database, which is configured so that this website can only add new entries and can never read, alter, or delete existing ones; only our practice can access stored submissions directly. This site uses cookies to understand general site usage, which you can decline. If you have questions about your privacy or wish to request that your information be corrected or deleted, please contact us directly.
